voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: My name is Draco. I am Sodom's Beast, Draco. Umu...ah, yes, that's correct. My class is Beast. Fufu...hahahahaha! This is a hoot! You have truly hit the jackpot!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: The curtain has risen. Tremble, sinners... for you have piled up your wealth on this earth, hoping to reach the heavens! Let me respond to your desire... ...with my Babalon Domus Aurea!

voiceLines.title: Summoning

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Nice to meet you! Hehe, I've actually been watching you for a long time already. My name's Nahida. I might look like a child, but don't be fooled: I understand this world much better than any grown-up. So... can we trade knowledge? I want to hear all about your travel stories. So, what would you like to know in return?

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: The Temple of Wisdom.

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: The current head of Fisalia, Cantarella, the Bane. Whether I am the Bane of the wicked or the pure is yours to decide. Shh, no need to answer. The moment you arrived, the ripples that surrounded you told me all I needed to know.

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Sleep, in the whispers of sirens.

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: This is me, having overcome my sunset in my lifetime. What is wrong? You need not hold back. Praise me to your heart's content. Hm? You want to know what was with the attitude I had earlier? Oh...I was just a little embarrassed. Read the room.

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Calamity comes from the sea... Behold. This is the answer to your prosperity. It is the twinkling of a meteor that slashes across the sky of desire! Babalon Domus Aurea!

name: Dante Alighieri
jpName: ダンテ・アリギエーリ

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Greetings, I am Kyryll Chudomirovich Flins. It is considered good etiquette to give my full name when greeting important guests, but this no doubt leaves you wondering what to call me on a day-to-day basis... Well, in the past, I was customarily addressed as

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: The long sleep beckons.

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: A summons… a summons? Hehe… well done, summoning me… My name is Dante Alighieri… As you know, I am the author of the Divine Comedy… As a Pretender, I am also the main character of the Divine Comedy… Hehe… in summary… I look forward to your continued support…

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Ah, the seat of God has vanished—all that remains is this gate to Hell! Don’t look, don’t look! Worms bore through the brain; Hell begins its march! “Lasciate ogne speranza, voi ch'intrate!”

lore: Dante Alighieri record archived in Chaldea.

name: Jacques de Molay
jpName: ジャック・ド・モレー

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: I am The Knave, Arlecchino, Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. The children of the House of the Hearth call me

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Everlasting as the moon.

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Greetings, my name is Danjin. I'm currently patrolling the lands as a ranger. Tell me about any injustice you've encountered, and I'll get it dealt with. You can't think of any? That's good.

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Judgement!

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Make way, make way...I'm Molay! I'm the final Grand Master of the Knights Templar! Well, that's what I'm known for, but a lot of people forced a bunch of other stuff on me and, long story short, they gave me a bad rep and burned me at the stake. So it's not my fault I ended up being labeled

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Ave, ave, Domina... Chant, my eternal brothers. Call Gehenna and the divine punishment of Eden to this land! May anguish echo everywhere, and let it be wholly heartless. Deliver those bastards what they've always desired! Vendredi Treize!

lore: Jacques de Molay record archived in Chaldea.

name: Xu Fu

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: I am Citlali from the Masters of the Night-Wind. I have read the stars and seen the future through the obscuring smoke. You shall be blessed with good fortune and have the aid of powerful allies during your journey. Allow me to join you — Hey, I can be serious! Stop looking at me like that!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Suffer the wrath of Itztli!

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: I'm Zhezhi… I do commissioned paintings. Um, what else...? Oh, I'm open for commissions! I offer fair prices, can adapt to any style you need, and do revisions too. And I never miss a deadline!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Witness the art's true form!

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Servant, Caster-now-Alter Ego. My True Name is Xu F... GYAAAH! Wha, no way, is this Chaldea!? Oh, come on! You got a grudge against me or something!? Huh? Hold up. ...Lady Yu. Hey, is Lady Yu here!? She is, isn't she!? Hurry, show me where she is! Hurry up!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Four Symbols. Infinitude. Yellow Dragon. Tranquility. Yonder. Spiral. After two thousand and two hundred years, I now make my report to His Imperial Majesty. I present to you the elixir of eternal life. It's a lie, though.

lore: Xu Fu record archived in Chaldea.

name: Archetype: Earth
jpName: アーキタイプ: アース

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: I have reconfigured myself to suit the stage of Chaldea. I am neither the original nor my newest self... No, this is a fleeting dream, a what-if version who was never driven mad by blood— The Princess of the True Ancestors, in the fullest sense.

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Submit. There is no path to my distant home. This castle is my final cage. ...Welcome to my lunar citadel.

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Just kidding! That's enough of the high-and-mighty me! Hi there, person from Chaldea! I'm a Moon Cancer, Arcueid Brunestud! It's nice to meet you! I'll see you soon, when we hit my second Ascension!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: You guys stay put, okay? Gracefully, quietly, like a flower in bloom. Marble Strike!

voiceLines.title: Summon
voiceLines.text: Hi～! I'm the White Moon Princess, Phantasmoon～!! Thanks for waiting～! I'm a gorgeous and pure white princess! On top of that, I'm a magical girl that KILLS. EVIL. AT ONCE! Eh? What's with that face? Don't tell me I surprised you.

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Found you! Receive the Moon's strike! I'll crush you all together! “Marble Phantasm – Happy Verse”!!

voiceLines.title: Summon
voiceLines.text: Sorry for hiding it until now. This is the real me. Yes, Phantasmoon is my provisional name to hide from society. I'm, the True Ancestor from space that came from the Univer-… se? And my name's Space Phantasmoon! That's right! This is what's trendy now, isn't it? Um, I'll do it too, I'll do it〜! White Moon Princess, Season 2, Phantasmoon V! A dashing debut from the surface of the moon! And also… You're interested in the private life of royalty, aren't you…?

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: I’ll show you my real, real strength! Everyone from the earth, are you ready to go to Heaven? “Marble Phantasm – Happy Verse”!! The V for Victory is the V for Vamp☆

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Sorry for hiding it until now & thank you for your support! That’s right, this is how I am this time, a genuine Earthling, the embodiment of the holy night, Santasmoon! I’ll hand out presents with unprecedented energy, and make everyone from Earth happy! Prepare yourself!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Turning the feelings of gratitude into power ─── I invite you to the Moon’s world. Roar! “Happy Verse - TAKE MOON”! Let’s meet next year.

voiceLines.title: Summon
voiceLines.text: Just kidding! That's enough of the high-and-mighty me! Hi there, person from Chaldea! I'm a Moon Cancer, Arcueid Brunestud! It's nice to meet you! I'll see you soon, when we hit my second Ascension!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: You guys stay put, okay? Gracefully, quietly, like a flower in bloom. Marble Strike!

voiceLines.title: Summon
voiceLines.text: You can call me Columbina, or Kuutar, or Moon Goddess... Whatever you prefer. I'm used to having many names. The moon's blessing is yours, whenever you might find yourself in need.

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Three moons converge.

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Worry not if you don't remember me... I can always introduce myself again. I am the Shorekeeper, acting executive of the Black Shores, and the core computational unit of Tethys. Now and forever, I will stand by you and our home, through every yesterday and tomorrow.

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: In war with Time.

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Am I...a Servant? I have no name, but my state of being is... Ah, yes. You may call me the Original One, or the Ultimate One. Some connection between us must have allowed you to summon me. For now, I shall observe whether you all manage to survive or not.

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: The planet's memories... Wind. Waves. Light. Terminus. Rupture in the palm of my hand...!

name: James Moriarty
jpName: ジェームズ・モリアーティ

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: I have come in response to your summoning. Ruler class, James Moriarty. Who knew I'd be summoned because my future was just THAT bright...I guess I'm not too shabby at all! Hm? I'm the greatest villain in all of Europe? What are you talking about?

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Malignancy should be removed and eliminated. It must be true, because I say so! Mathemalignancy: Annihilation!!!

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: *Yawn* That was a refreshing sleep. Ah, Traveler, we meet again! What? You don't remember me? Ahaha, well, allow me to join you on your quest once again. I must see to it that the bards of the world tell the Traveler's tales!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Think you can get away?

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Hiya, I'm Lingyang. You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember what I look like, without the liondance head!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: Lions rumble, evil crumble!

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Even in a world-ending disaster, Captain Nemo won’t be disheartened! I won’t overlook the shine on this heart! Savior Pretty Boy Nemo Zohar, makes his entrance! …Just kidding. How’s that? I’m reliable, am I not, Master? I’m your Rider, borrowing the Heroic Spirit Noah’s power. Nemo Zohar, Nemo/Noah, Big Brother Nemo, call me the way you want!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: The promised ship is here! Travel around the wheel of earth, spread your wings under storms and thunder, and show the wrath of heavens!”Great Ram, Noah’s Ark”!

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: I am Vritra. Honestly, what does a mere human like you intend to do with a serpent like me? I am a demon who only acts on my own desires. You better not think you can tame me.

voiceLines.title: Dialogue
voiceLines.text: O heavens...the heavens obstructed by the phantasmagoric scales. O earth...the earth swallowed by the jaws of gluttony. The great serpent shall block even those laments. Asurasreshta.

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Yahoo!, it's me! We've not talked since that whole Hell thing! How've you been? Oh, just kidding around. Mm, I guess with how strong of a bond we got going there, I'd be pulled over here whether I wanted to or not. Sure, why not? So... here I am, Lilith, Manifestation of Storm and Night. Though I don't imagine an introduction is necessary. Pleased to meet you. Ah, and I'll make sure to keep my distance from Kyrielight. It's for the better, right? In terms of your mental health, at least.

voiceLines.title: NP
voiceLines.text: Law becomes null. Moderation becomes conflict. Flatlands become mountainous. All melt and turn to chaos. Isha Ra'a! Now, the nightmare begins..

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Ho there! Are you the Master? Well met. Servant, Assassin. I'm Tezcatlipoca. As you can see, I'm an intellectual. Talking to people is my favorite pastime... Relax. I actually love war. Don't get all worked up, now. Let's enjoy this, Master.

voiceLines.title: NP
voiceLines.text: Ehēcatl, ehēcatl. Yohualli ehēcatl, titlacahuan. The time of doom is nigh. ...To the next world with you. Tonal tepēyōllōtl!

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Servant, Anastasia. I have come in answer to your call. This little one is Viy. Please take good care of us both.

voiceLines.title: NP
voiceLines.text: Viy, I beg you. Curse them all, freeze them all, kill them all! Activate Mystic Eyes... Go, Viy!

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Servant, Archer. Tam Lin Tristan has come in response to your summons. I swear never to bring disgrace upon my knightly name. ...As if! Kyahahahahaha! You really don't know a thing about me, do you!? That's hilarious! I might actually like you! Anyway, let's be friends. I, too, champion justice after all.

voiceLines.title: NP
voiceLines.text: It's show time. See? Everything's already finished. This is the end of you. Fetch Failnaught.

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Shinmen Musashi-no-Kami Fujiwara-no-Harunob...!? Sorry, let me start over! Servant Saber, Shinmen Musashi at your service! Make my stay a fun one, Master!

voiceLines.title: NP
voiceLines.text: Namu, Tenman Daijizai Tenjin! Nioh Kurikara! Shoutenshou! Come hither, my roaring sword, now unsheathed! Ishana, Daitenshou!

voiceLines.title: Summon
voiceLines.text: No salutations needed. My exalted status shall not be disclosed as we travel among the common folk. I acknowledge that you are a person of superior ability. Henceforth, you will be my guard. Worry not. Should any danger arise, I shall dispose of it.

voiceLines.title: Elemental Burst
voiceLines.text: Inazuma shines eternal!

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: To think that I'd be an Avenger... Uwahaha! What twisted fate. Very well! Behold the way the Demon king of the Sixth Heaven, Nobunaga lives, and engrave it into your very soul!

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: The past, present, and future... All of me...assemble and unleash! Pāpīyas Reborn, Demon King of the Myriad Heavens!!!

name: Artoria Pendragon
jpName: アルトリア・ペンドラゴン

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: I ask of you, are you my Master?

voiceLines.title: Noble Phantasm
voiceLines.text: This light is the planet's hope...proof of the life that illuminates this world! Behold! Ex... CALIBUR!

skills.name: Charisma A
skills.effect: Increases ATK for all allies (3 turns).

skills.name: Mana Burst A
skills.effect: Increases Buster Performance for yourself (1 turn).

skills.name: Intuition A
skills.effect: Gains a large amount of Critical Stars.

lore: The legendary King of Knights who pulled the sword from the stone and united ancient Britain.
Holder of the Holy Sword Excalibur, she wields the light of hope to protect mankind.

name: Gilgamesh

voiceLines.title: Summoning
voiceLines.text: Hahaha! For you to summon me like this, I see your luck has run out, Mongrel!

voiceLines.title: NP
voiceLines.text: The elements coalesce and solidify to bring forth the star where creation interweaves. In death, you will bow before it. Enuma Elish!

skills.name: Charisma A+
skills.effect: Greatly increases ATK for all allies (3 turns).

skills.name: Golden Rule A
skills.effect: Increases own NP Generation Rate (3 turns).

skills.name: Treasury of Babylon A
skills.effect: Increases own Star Absorption Rate and charges NP.

lore: The oldest King in human history, who ruled Uruk in ancient Mesopotamia.
Possesses the originals of all Noble Phantasms stored inside the Gate of Babylon.
